title: Associated Types
goal: Define placeholder types in traits that implementers supply.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Associated Types

sections.text: An associated type is a placeholder type declared inside a trait. The implementer chooses the concrete type when implementing the trait.

sections.caption: type Item declares an associated type placeholder.

sections.text: You will notice this differs from generics. With generics, the caller picks the type. With associated types, the implementer picks it once per type.

sections.caption: Self::Item is set to i32 in the implementation.

sections.text: Standard library traits like `Iterator` and `Add` use associated types for their outputs.
Next, you will specify an associated type on a custom trait.

explanation: Define placeholder types in traits that implementers supply.
